android.desc:
🌱 Build Better Habits with HabitHook
HabitHook is a habit tracker app, streak tracker, and accountability app designed to help you build habits that actually stick — by doing it with friends, not alone. Whether you're working on fitness, mindfulness, productivity, or breaking bad habits, HabitHook keeps you consistent through real social accountability, not empty reminders.
⭐ Key Features

🤝 Social Habit Tracking
- Follow friends and people who inspire you
- Build habits together — their daily progress pushes yours
- Not anonymous leaderboards — people you actually know keeping you on track

📊 Daily Habit Tracker & Streak Tracker
- Track unlimited habits with flexible schedules — daily, weekly, or custom
- Beautiful progress charts across days, weeks, and months
- Build good habits like fitness, journaling, or meditation; break bad ones like scrolling

🏆 Habit Challenges
- Join public habit challenges or create private ones with friends
- 30 day habit challenges — Morning Routine, No Sugar Month, Code Every Day
- Commit, show up daily, and stay accountable together

✨ Highlights Feed
- Your milestone streaks and personal records auto-surface to the community feed
- You do the work — HabitHook tells your story

👏 Cheers System
- Cheer others only if you have an active 7 day streak yourself
- Earned recognition, not empty likes

🔍 Follow & Discover Habit Builders
- Find friends whose consistency inspires you
- Share your profile via QR code — friends join your challenges instantly

🔔 Smart Habit Reminders
- Custom reminders timed to when you actually perform best
- The right nudge at the right time, not generic daily pings

⭐ HabitHook Pro — Deep Habit Analytics
- Consistency Score — your overall habit score out of 100
- Deep Analysis — peak performance time, strongest/weakest day, habit-by-habit breakdown
- My League — private comparison with your Circle, no public rankings
- Advanced Challenges — deeper tracking for serious habit builders

💪 Perfect For
- Building habits with friends instead of alone
- Fitness, mindfulness & morning routine tracking
- Study, productivity & focus habits
- Breaking bad habits with real accountability
- Anyone who's quit a solo habit tracker before

🎯 Why Choose HabitHook?
